## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector breadth ≥7/11 and clear strength in Financials and Healthcare (multiple ABOVE TREND names: MA, V, JNJ, UNH, LLY); Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5), Style: Growth/Momentum.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong on 1W breadth: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY. Financials show durable participation: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak: CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND. Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate soft: DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY, APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology), so be selective despite strong leaders.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: T (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -16.48%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -8.84% | 1M: +5.90%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +11.51%) CORRECTION, AMAT (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%) CORRECTION, DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Tech names and Utilities/Real Estate.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY. Major divergence present (≥3 large-cap names with 1W ≠ 1M) — tactical caution: watch for trend confirmation rather than assuming broad continuation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology: 24 stocks, 1W +3.19% (positive). Mixed internal picture — PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) while NVDA (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND and several megacaps in RECOVERY (AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%) RECOVERY); internal rotation within Tech.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials: 20 stocks, 1W +2.69% (positive). Broad participation with MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND and V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND; JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) in CORRECTION — overall Financials favored in this risk-on leg.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare: 17 stocks, 1W +4.42% (positive). Defensive and cyclical mix with JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND; sector showing leadership breadth.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and Healthcare exposure given broad participation and ABOVE TREND leaders (MA, V, JNJ, UNH, LLY); reduce exposure to Utilities and select Energy names showing BELOW TREND. Monitor narrow Tech leadership and the major short-term divergence in large caps — treat Tech strength as tactical until 1M confirmations broaden.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -16.48%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W +4.42%) and Financials (1W +2.69%) — watch for continuation into next week. BEARISH: Utilities (1W -1.24%) and Energy (1W -0.80%) where weakness is notable and could widen if macro tone shifts.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming 1M downtrend is required to shift sentiment; AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY — holds this week’s gains to confirm bounce; MA/V continuation above recent highs would confirm broader Financials leadership; QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND — further downside would signal deeper tech regrouping.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PLTR (+55): Palantir upgrade; PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY — price rally confirms sentiment but 1M drag suggests tactical move not full trend flip. (Other top bullish headlines noted in feed — cross-check before positioning.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
APD (-50): Listed bearish coverage despite APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND — clear news/price divergence, monitor for distribution. CEG (-45): Citi cut; CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Growth/Momentum tilt; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive and leadership is Narrow (4/5 Technology). MA, V, JNJ, UNH, LLY are showing strength (ABOVE TREND) while several large techs are in RECOVERY or BELOW TREND. Key risk: major short-term divergence among big caps (multiple 1W↑ / 1M↓) and mixed news (e.g., APD bearish headlines vs strong price) — watch for trend confirmation.
